BLDP-3.label: proposed_not_promoted
BLDP-3.rationale: Ballard's PFIC self-classification is economically equivalent to asserting that its operating revenue is dwarfed by interest on cash / securities, OR that >=50% of assets are cash/marketable securities. SEC Company Facts XBRL exposes both numerators and denominators, so the assertion is structurally adjudicatable via PFIC-test arithmetic on the issuer's own audited financials — but no existing catalog connector exposes Company Facts XBRL.
BLDP-3.note: score UNVERIFIABLE; connector not yet built

BLDP-4.label: proposed_not_promoted
BLDP-4.rationale: Auditor relationship is one of the few vendor relationships with a federal registry (PCAOB). For going-concern-risk cohort members (PFIC, negative operating cash flow), auditor identity and any pre-cutoff inspection findings or restrictions are material. No catalog connector currently exposes PCAOB.
BLDP-4.endpoint: https://pcaobus.org/oversight/inspections/firm-inspection-reports and https://pcaobus.org/resources/auditorsearch and PCAOB Form AP search at https://pcaobus.org/oversight/standards/auditing-standards/details/form-ap-search
BLDP-4.note: score UNVERIFIABLE; connector not yet built
